description: A Flutter Windows app crashes after updating to Flutter 3.16 when Dart numeric operations hit a native VM crash on some machines, from https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/138693.
prompt:
After updating Flutter, a few Windows users say the app just never opens. I narrowed one repro to this line, but none of my Dart error handlers fire.

```
return (source * factor).ceil();
PlatformDispatcher.instance.onError, FlutterError.onError, runZonedGuarded, and try/catch do not catch anything.
```
